text:
mike: deploy-bot just flagged a canary regression in eu-west after the values bump. ~20% of canary pods returning 502s. change was db.maxConnections=5000 in values.yaml yesterday. do we pin chart+values or rollback the values-only?

deploy-bot: [ALERT] canary-failure eu-west - 4/20 pods failing healthcheck (502) - recent release 2024-07-20T09:12Z - annotation: values.bumped-by=values-sync-job-7

sara: timeline? is this only eu-west canary or spreading to staging/prod?

mike: only seeing it in eu-west canary so far. staging and prod healthy. metrics show connection pool saturation and short-lived spikes in backend 502s right after prefix cache misses.

olivia: values-sync job bumped both chart and a generated values overlay. Looks like connection pool default was unintentionally raised. My vote: pin the chart+values for the next promotion and do a values-only rollback for the canary to the previous safe pool value (120).

raja: I can push a canary-scoped values override immediately to revert pool size. Quick command:

```
kubectl -n eu-west patch configmap myapp-values --type merge -p '{"data":{"db.maxConnections":"120"}}'
kubectl -n eu-west rollout restart deploy/myapp-canary
```

That will restore the pool without touching the chart itself. If we still see failures after 10m we pin the chart version in the release bot and open a rollback.

mike: sounds good. sara, can you update release-notes and mark a hold on promotion until canary is stable? also request a temp exemption for values-sync job for this app.

sara: on it. adding a note: "reverted automated values bump for db.maxConnections; holding promotion pending 30m of stable canary. action: pin chart to v1.7.2 for next promotion if instability continues."

deploy-bot: action taken -> pinned release candidate: myapp-chart v1.7.3 -> pinned v1.7.2 for eu-west canary promotion; ticket #INF-4821 created.

mike: thanks. raja please watch logs for 15m and report back with pod restarts + 502 count.

raja: patch applied, rolling restart triggered. I'll post a short followup in 15m. :hourglass:
